children: Charlton Aria Acquisition reported lower third-quarter net income year over year as trust-account interest and dividends declined and formation and operating costs rose, mainly due to professional fees for its proposed business combination with KQC Quantum.
: Signed an agreement with KQC Quantum on October 6; the proposed transaction sets Parent’s equity value at $80 million.
: Shareholders approved up to 12 one-month deadline extensions, through October 25, 2027; each requires a $60,000 trust deposit.
: Holders redeemed 5,725,962 public shares for $63.2 million; $30.6 million remained in the trust account afterward.
: At September 30, cash was $30,962 and working capital deficit was $2.9 million; management cited substantial doubt about going concern.
